product_one_liner.value: Nanonets provides AI agents that read, validate, route and post document data to automate document-heavy enterprise workflows such as accounts payable, order management, logistics and healthcare revenue cycle.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in the product page’s customer logo wall.

employee_band.notes: Y Combinator lists a team size of 102.

eng_blog.notes: Research posts cover OCR-2 model training and OCR-3 architecture and training infrastructure. OCR-2 is authored by Senior Deep Learning Engineer Souvik Mandal; OCR-3 is credited collectively to Nanonets Research.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation contains numerous product, API and workflow articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A live Senior Deep Learning Engineer posting was verified on November 9, 2026.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims include SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001 certification; GDPR is described as alignment, and HIPAA BAAs are available for enterprise plans.

last_funding.notes: Announced March 12, 2024 as a $29 million Series B led by Accel.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was March 12, 2024, before the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Enterprise Account Executive opening in Palo Alto.

launched_6mo.notes: Atlas launched on June 26, 2026, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Shubhra Mishra’s profile lists a March 2026 start as Vice President, Strategic Initiatives.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are publicly listed CRM integrations, not confirmation that Nanonets uses either internally.
